updates.claim: When the complete evidence universe is small and cheap enough for one bounded synthesis, serial Agent-controlled evidence acquisition may be less tractable than full inspection because selection overhead and path dependence can dominate evidence cost.
updates.evidenceSummary: 8/8 progressive trials consumed 6/6 windows and required forced evidence-exhaustion finalization; progressive agreed with unanimous full references 6/8 and used about 2.3x matched one-shot Provider tokens per case.

rejected: serial Agent self-questioning as a default marginal-value stopping operator for short Game trajectories
interpreting zero false-early-stop count as success when zero autonomous early stops occurred
assuming adaptive evidence selection is cheaper merely because it is selective in principle
remainingGap: Estimate marginal evidence value without one serial Provider decision per observation, and test stopping only where full evidence inspection is materially expensive enough that selection overhead can plausibly pay for itself.
